flowElements.questionText: Did you contribute to a Commonwealth Savers account in 2024?
flowElements.rawXml:
<fg-set path="/vaHasCommonwealthSaversContributions">
  <question>Did you contribute to a Commonwealth Savers account in 2024?</question>
  <input type="boolean">
    <option value="true">Yes</option>
    <option value="false">No</option>
  </input>
</fg-set>

flowElements.questionText: Amount contributed to Commonwealth Savers accounts
flowElements.rawXml:
<fg-set path="/vaCommonwealthSaversContributions">
  <question>Amount contributed to Commonwealth Savers accounts</question>
  <hint>Up to $4,000 is deducted, unless you are 70 or older, in which case all of it is.</hint>
  <input type="dollar"/>
</fg-set>

Line 12, exemptions:

× for you, a spouse on a joint return and each dependent, , plus × for each of you who is 65 or older or blind, (§ 58.1-322.03(2)).

The 65 or older and blind part is left off because the return claims a low-income credit instead. See Line 23.

facts.name: Is claimed dependent
facts.description: Whether the person is both allowed to be claimed as a dependent, and has been claimed as a dependent. Exists as a derived fact to ensure that an edit that disqualifies a person as a dependent causes them to no longer count as a dependent.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/familyAndHousehold/*/isClaimedDependent">
  <Name>Is claimed dependent</Name>
  <Description>Whether the person is both allowed to be claimed as a dependent, and has been claimed as a dependent.
        Exists as a derived fact to ensure that an edit that disqualifies a person as a dependent causes them to no
        longer count as a dependent.</Description>
  <Export downstreamFacts="true" stateSystems="true"/>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="../tpClaims"/>
      <Dependency path="../eligibleDependent"/>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Wages, salaries, tips, etc.
facts.description: Wage income to report on line 1a of Form 1040.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/wages">
  <Name>Wages, salaries, tips, etc.</Name>
  <Description>Wage income to report on line 1a of Form 1040.</Description>
  <Export downstreamFacts="true" mef="true"/>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <CollectionSum>
        <Dependency path="/formW2s/*/wages"/>
      </CollectionSum>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Virginia standard deduction, Filing Status 1 and 3
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b): $8,500 for taxable years beginning 2024-01-01 and before 2025-01-01 (single; married filing separately takes one-half of the married amount, also $8,500). 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 11.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaStandardDeductionSingle">
  <Name>Virginia standard deduction, Filing Status 1 and 3</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b): $8,500 for taxable years beginning 2024-01-01
        and before 2025-01-01 (single; married filing separately takes one-half of the married
        amount, also $8,500). 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 11.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>8500</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Virginia standard deduction, Filing Status 2
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b): $17,000 for married persons filing jointly, taxable year 2024. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 11.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaStandardDeductionMarried">
  <Name>Virginia standard deduction, Filing Status 2</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b): $17,000 for married persons filing jointly,
        taxable year 2024. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 11.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>17000</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Virginia personal exemption
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(a): $930 for each personal exemption allowable federally. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section A.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPersonalExemptionAmount">
  <Name>Virginia personal exemption</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(a): $930 for each personal exemption allowable
        federally. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section A.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>930</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Virginia additional exemption, 65 or older or blind
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(b): $800 for a taxpayer who is aged or blind under IRC § 63(f). 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section B: 65 or older on or before January 1, 2025.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionAmount">
  <Name>Virginia additional exemption, 65 or older or blind</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(b): $800 for a taxpayer who is aged or blind under
        IRC § 63(f). 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section B: 65 or older on or before
        January 1, 2025.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>800</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Commonwealth Savers deduction cap
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(a): "limited to $4,000 per prepaid tuition contract or college savings trust account" per return per taxable year. This prototype treats the contributions as one account; the carryforward of the excess to later years is out of scope.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCommonwealthSaversCap">
  <Name>Commonwealth Savers deduction cap</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(a): "limited to $4,000 per prepaid tuition contract or college
        savings trust account" per return per taxable year. This prototype treats the contributions as
        one account; the carryforward of the excess to later years is out of scope.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>4000</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Commonwealth Savers, last birth date for the no-cap rule
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(b): a contributor who has attained age 70 is not subject to the $4,000 limit. Born on or before December 31, 1954 has attained 70 during tax year 2024.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCommonwealthSaversAge70BirthDateCutoff">
  <Name>Commonwealth Savers, last birth date for the no-cap rule</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(b): a contributor who has attained age 70 is not subject to
        the $4,000 limit. Born on or before December 31, 1954 has attained 70 during tax year 2024.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Day>1954-12-31</Day>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 11, poverty guideline for the family size
facts.description: 2024 Poverty Guideline Table: $15,060 for one, plus $5,380 for each more person. Family size is the You, Spouse and Dependents count (/vaPersonalExemptionCount).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPovertyGuideline">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 11, poverty guideline for the family size</Name>
  <Description>2024 Poverty Guideline Table: $15,060 for one, plus $5,380 for each more person.
        Family size is the You, Spouse and Dependents count (/vaPersonalExemptionCount).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaPovertyGuidelineFirstPerson"/>
      <Multiply>
        <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaPovertyGuidelineEachAdditionalPerson"/>
        <Subtract>
          <Minuend>
            <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount"/>
          </Minuend>
          <Subtrahends>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Subtrahends>
        </Subtract>
      </Multiply>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ Line 13, Credit for Low-Income Individuals
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1): $300 times the personal and dependent exemptions (Schedule ADJ Line 12; not the 65 or older or blind ones), if the family qualifies.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ Line 13, Credit for Low-Income Individuals</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1): $300 times the personal and dependent exemptions
        (Schedule ADJ Line 12; not the 65 or older or blind ones), if the family qualifies.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaQualifiesForCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Multiply>
            <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaLowIncomeCreditPerExemption"/>
            <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount"/>
          </Multiply>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: The return claims a low-income credit
facts.description: The election Form 760 leaves to the filer: the instructions for Line 4 say to "claim the deduction or subtraction that gives you the greatest tax benefit." The return claims a credit when there is one and the tax less the credit is lower than the tax keeping everything Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D) says the filer, the spouse or both would give up: the age deduction of either spouse, the 65 or older and blind exemptions of either spouse, and the military basic pay subtraction. Withholding, payments and use tax are the same either way, so this is the whole comparison.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit">
  <Name>The return claims a low-income credit</Name>
  <Description>The election Form 760 leaves to the filer: the instructions for Line 4 say to
        "claim the deduction or subtraction that gives you the greatest tax benefit." The return
        claims a credit when there is one and the tax less the credit is lower than the tax keeping
        everything Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D) says the filer, the spouse or both would give up: the age
        deduction of either spouse, the 65 or older and blind exemptions of either spouse, and the
        military basic pay subtraction. Withholding, payments and use tax are the same either way, so
        this is the whole comparison.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/vaBestLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
      <LessThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithCreditTaxAfterCredit"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dependency module="virginiaTax" path="/vaWithoutCreditTax"/>
        </Right>
      </LessThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Claiming the credit gave up the 65 or older or blind exemptions
facts.description: Shown on the summary, so the filer sees what the credit replaced and what it was worth; on a joint return the figure includes the spouse's boxes.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditReplacedAgedOrBlindExemptions">
  <Name>Claiming the credit gave up the 65 or older or blind exemptions</Name>
  <Description>Shown on the summary, so the filer sees what the credit replaced and what it was
        worth; on a joint return the figure includes the spouse's boxes.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionsAllowed"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Standard deduction amount for this filing status
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b). Federal itemizers must itemize in Virginia (Line 10); that case is out of scope, so every return here takes the standard deduction.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaStandardDeductionForFilingStatus">
  <Name>Standard deduction amount for this filing status</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b). Federal itemizers must itemize in Virginia (Line
        10); that case is out of scope, so every return here takes the standard deduction.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaStandardDeductionMarried"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaStandardDeductionSingle"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 11, standard deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b): a person who can be claimed as a dependent on another's return takes the deduction only with respect to earned income; 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 11, "Dependent on Another's Return": the smaller of earned income and the standard deduction. Earned income here is W-2 wages (/wages, exported to MeF).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaStandardDeduction">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 11, standard deduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(1)(b): a person who can be claimed as a dependent on
        another's return takes the deduction only with respect to earned income; 2024 Form 760
        instructions, Line 11, "Dependent on Another's Return": the smaller of earned income and
        the standard deduction. Earned income here is W-2 wages (/wages, exported to MeF).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="filers" path="/primaryFiler/canBeClaimed"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="/vaStandardDeductionForFilingStatus"/>
            <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/wages"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaStandardDeductionForFilingStatus"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Exemptions claimed in the You, Spouse and Dependents boxes
facts.description: 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section A: yourself, your spouse on a joint return, and the dependents claimed federally, counted from each household member's isClaimedDependent, which the federal return exports to states. (The federal /claimedDependentsCount is not exported, so it is not read.)
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount">
  <Name>Exemptions claimed in the You, Spouse and Dependents boxes</Name>
  <Description>2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section A: yourself, your spouse on a
        joint return, and the dependents claimed federally, counted from each household member's
        isClaimedDependent, which the federal return exports to states. (The federal
        /claimedDependentsCount is not exported, so it is not read.)</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Int>1</Int>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>0</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
      <Count>
        <Dependency module="familyAndHousehold" path="/familyAndHousehold/*/isClaimedDependent"/>
      </Count>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Exemptions claimed in the 65 or older and Blind boxes
facts.description: 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section B, four boxes: you 65 or older on or before January 1, 2025 (the federal /age65OrOlder rule), you blind for federal purposes, and on a joint return the same two for your spouse.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionCount">
  <Name>Exemptions claimed in the 65 or older and Blind boxes</Name>
  <Description>2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions Section B, four boxes: you 65 or older on or
        before January 1, 2025 (the federal /age65OrOlder rule), you blind for federal purposes, and
        on a joint return the same two for your spouse.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency module="filers" path="/primaryFiler/age65OrOlder"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>0</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency module="filers" path="/primaryFiler/isBlind"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>0</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaSpouseAge65OrOlder"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>0</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaSpouseIsBlind"/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>1</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Int>0</Int>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Exemptions, Section A amount
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(a): $930 times the You, Spouse and Dependents count.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPersonalExemptions">
  <Name>Exemptions, Section A amount</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(a): $930 times the You, Spouse and Dependents count.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Multiply>
      <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaPersonalExemptionAmount"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaPersonalExemptionCount"/>
    </Multiply>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Exemptions, Section B amount the filers qualify for
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(b): $800 times the 65 or older and Blind count, the spouse's boxes included. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions: these cannot be claimed with a Credit for Low-Income Individuals on Line 23 (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(4) bars every low-income credit when the filer or the spouse claims one).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionsAllowed">
  <Name>Exemptions, Section B amount the filers qualify for</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2)(b): $800 times the 65 or older and Blind count, the
        spouse's boxes included. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Exemptions: these cannot be claimed with
        a Credit for Low-Income Individuals on Line 23 (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(4) bars every
        low-income credit when the filer or the spouse claims one).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Multiply>
      <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionAmount"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionCount"/>
    </Multiply>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 12 if the return keeps the 65 or older and blind exemptions
facts.description: Line 12 as it stands when no low-income credit is claimed: the personal exemptions plus the 65-or-older and blind exemptions, § 58.1-322.03(2). The credits module's switch picks this or the personal exemptions alone.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditExemptions">
  <Name>Line 12 if the return keeps the 65 or older and blind exemptions</Name>
  <Description>Line 12 as it stands when no low-income credit is claimed: the personal exemptions plus the 65-or-older and blind exemptions, § 58.1-322.03(2). The credits module's switch picks this or the personal exemptions alone.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/vaPersonalExemptions"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaAgedOrBlindExemptionsAllowed"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 12, exemptions
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2): Section A plus Section B, or Section A alone when the return claims a low-income credit.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaExemptions">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 12, exemptions</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(2): Section A plus Section B, or Section A alone when the
        return claims a low-income credit.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaCredits" path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaPersonalExemptions"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithoutCreditExemptions"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 14 if the return keeps the 65 or older and blind exemptions
facts.description: Line 14 as it stands when no low-income credit is claimed: the standard deduction, both kinds of exemption and the Commonwealth Savers deduction. /vaTotalDeductions picks this or /vaWithCreditTotalDeductions.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditTotalDeductions">
  <Name>Line 14 if the return keeps the 65 or older and blind exemptions</Name>
  <Description>Line 14 as it stands when no low-income credit is claimed: the standard deduction, both kinds of exemption and the Commonwealth Savers deduction. /vaTotalDeductions picks this or /vaWithCreditTotalDeductions.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/vaStandardDeduction"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaWithoutCreditExemptions"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaCommonwealthSaversDeduction"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 14 if the return claims a low-income credit
facts.description: Line 14 as it stands when a low-income credit is claimed: the standard deduction, the personal exemptions alone (the credit bars the 65-or-older and blind exemptions, § 58.1-339.8(D)) and the Commonwealth Savers deduction.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithCreditTotalDeductions">
  <Name>Line 14 if the return claims a low-income credit</Name>
  <Description>Line 14 as it stands when a low-income credit is claimed: the standard deduction, the personal exemptions alone (the credit bars the 65-or-older and blind exemptions, § 58.1-339.8(D)) and the Commonwealth Savers deduction.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/vaStandardDeduction"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaPersonalExemptions"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaCommonwealthSaversDeduction"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 14, total deductions
facts.description: Lines 10 + 11 + 12 + 13, whichever way the return files. Line 10 (itemized) and the Schedule ADJ deductions other than Commonwealth Savers are out of scope and taken as $0.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaTotalDeductions">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 14, total deductions</Name>
  <Description>Lines 10 + 11 + 12 + 13, whichever way the return files. Line 10 (itemized) and
        the Schedule ADJ deductions other than Commonwealth Savers are out of scope and taken as $0.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaCredits" path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithCreditTotalDeductions"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithoutCreditTotalDeductions"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 15 if the return keeps the age deduction and exemptions
facts.description: Line 9 minus Line 14, not below zero.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome">
  <Name>Line 15 if the return keeps the age deduction and exemptions</Name>
  <Description>Line 9 minus Line 14, not below zero.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
      <Subtract>

facts.name: Tax from the rate schedule, keeping the age deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-320, taxable years from 1990: 2% of income not exceeding $3,000; 3% of income over $3,000 to $5,000; 5% of income over $5,000 to $17,000; 5.75% of income over $17,000. Written as the cumulative schedule the 2024 Form 760 instructions print: $60 at $3,000, $120 at $5,000, $720 at $17,000 (the /vaRateSchedule… figures). Rounded to the dollar.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxFromRateSchedule">
  <Name>Tax from the rate schedule, keeping the age deduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-320, taxable years from 1990: 2% of income not exceeding
        $3,000; 3% of income over $3,000 to $5,000; 5% of income over $5,000 to $17,000; 5.75% of
        income over $17,000. Written as the cumulative schedule the 2024 Form 760 instructions
        print: $60 at $3,000, $120 at $5,000, $720 at $17,000 (the /vaRateSchedule… figures).
        Rounded to the dollar.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket1Top"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Multiply>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleRate1"/>
              <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
            </Multiply>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket2Top"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Add>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleTaxAtBracket1Top"/>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleRate2"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket1Top"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
            </Add>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket3Top"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Add>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleTaxAtBracket2Top"/>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleRate3"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket2Top"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
            </Add>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Add>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleTaxAtBracket3Top"/>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleRate4"/>
                <Subtract>
                  <Minuend>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaDeductions" path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome"/>
                  </Minuend>
                  <Subtrahends>
                    <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaRateScheduleBracket3Top"/>
                  </Subtrahends>
                </Subtract>
              </Multiply>
            </Add>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>
